# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game titled **Sewer Carnival: Fearlight Kids**. Preserve a free-roam survival collection loop: virtual joystick movement, two action buttons (GRAB and FLASH), collect nearby items into a 60-entry memory wall, hold one charm at a time, attack pursuing enemies in a facing arc, gain score/courage for defeated enemies, lose hearts on contact, and restart from a game-over panel.

Theme the runtime as an IT-inspired sewer carnival horror adventure. The player is a brave kid descending into a storm drain to recover childhood memory charms while shapeshifting clown manifestations stalk the playfield. Use procedural Canvas art: red balloons, drain channels, funhouse rings, carnival bulbs, fear mist, paper boats, clown faces, flashlight beams, and readable mobile HUD cards. Use Creepster for horror headings, Press Start 2P for counters, VT323 for readable copy, and eerie catalog audio.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first free-roam survival action / collection game.
- objective: move through a large scrolling world, collect randomly spawned items, discover a 60-entry collection index, defeat pursuing enemies for score, and survive with three hit points.
- input model: left virtual joystick or WASD/arrow keys for movement; GRAB/FLASH buttons or keyboard keys for collection and attack.
- core loop: start from menu, spawn player/items/enemies, roam, grab nearest collectible within range, hold one item, attack in a facing arc, score on enemy defeat, spawn more enemies/items over time, update HUD, continue until HP reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: enemy contact removes hearts with invulnerability cooldown; zero hearts opens a game-over panel with restart/menu options.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve free-roam movement speed/friction/camera follow and world bounds.
- Preserve joystick/button and keyboard semantics.
- Preserve proximity grab, one held item, rarity/item collection database, localStorage discovery, and memory wall/index behavior.
- Preserve enemy pursuit, collision contact damage, invulnerability, weapon arc attack, enemy HP, score gain, and item drop chance.
- Preserve start, play, game-over, restart, menu, and collection board state flow.

## Remixed target
Sewer Carnival: Fearlight Kids reframes the same loop as a coming-of-age horror descent into a drowned carnival sewer. The player is a brave kid carrying a flashlight and collecting childhood memory charms while shapeshifting clown fear-forms stalk the tunnels. Score becomes courage, hearts become bravery, collectibles become fears faced, and enemies become clown manifestations.
